text:
https://www.rgbloom.com/

RGBloom: create printed photo books in minutes (UK only for now) for just £10 including delivery. Been working on this for 8 months, recently launched iOS and Android apps to go alongside the web app. Got just a few dozen orders a week atm.

I'm focused on making it privacy first, keeping as little data as possible for as short a time as possible (no accounts, you don't even need to provide an email address, and if you do it's wiped in 30 days). And transparent pricing: not getting hit with large delivery fees at checkout, and no discounts just honest prices.
